subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window to a compact summary and the requested behavior adds a new public config/lifecycle policy rather than fixing broken documented behavior.

options.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current one-line collapse summary as the default.

options.title: Keep current collapse summary
options.body: Decline full completed-draft preservation for now and keep the current final answer plus compact activity digest behavior.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track checklist preservation as part of a broader cross-channel structured progress-card design instead of adding a Telegram-only config now.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete/finalization option while preserving the current one-line collapse summary as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent PR metadata connect vincentkoc most directly to the current progress-summary/config shape that this decision would extend.
